title: Micah 6:8 in the RSV requires justice, kindness, and a humble walk
summary: The RSV of Micah 6:8 says the Lord requires justice, kindness, and a humble walk.
body: The Revised Standard Version of Micah 6:8 answers what the Lord requires: to do justice, to love kindness, and to walk humbly with God. The wording on the page includes: "8 He has showed you, O man, what is good; and what does the Lord require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness,[a] and to walk humbly with your God?
